svg.title: Molecule of the day: Diclofenac
svg.desc: A rotating 3D structure of Diclofenac while a graph neural network predicts its lipophilicity (logD) as 1.33.
svg.text: MW 296.2 · cLogP 4.36 · TPSA 49.3 · HBD 2 · HBA 2 · RotB 4
3-layer message-passing GNN · 4,200 molecules · held-out RMSE 0.603 (R² 0.731) · descriptors from RDKit
